'''Bherizians''' were the inhabitants of [[Bheriz]].

==History==
Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Bherizians were contacted by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic]]. They were led by the [[Viceroy of Bheriz]].
